stem: A SaaS team is finalizing engine choice for a new managed relational platform and wants options aligned to documented discriminator criteria. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Prioritize MySQL when framework compatibility and simpler transactional behavior are the top needs.
Prioritize AWS Glue DataBrew for OLTP row-level transaction durability.
Prioritize PostgreSQL when custom extensions and advanced JSON processing are needed.
Prioritize Amazon Kendra as the SQL extension compatibility layer.
Prioritize Amazon Athena ACID mode for high-throughput online writes.

rationale: The documented discriminator says MySQL fits broad tool compatibility and simpler transactional workloads, while PostgreSQL fits advanced JSON, complex queries, and custom extensions. Glue DataBrew and Kendra are not relational OLTP engines. Athena is a query service over data lakes and not a primary online transactional engine.
